title: Kagamine Len — Joint Training!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Len, everyone!
Thank you for calling us over today!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You're playing the lead in your guys' show, right, Len? Break a leg!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks! I practiced a ton just for this day, so I hope you guys enjoy it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Alright, time to go blow them away...!)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You seem so excited, Len!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I thought you might be nervous, but it looks like you'll be just fine.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. All that's left is for me to do what I did during practice!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I'm glad you're the protagonist.
Anyway, let's get started!

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “We find a kind boy working hard on his sword fighting skills, but his timid nature prevents him from improving.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “Then, his older brother, a swordsman confident in his own skills, sees this and makes a declaration.”

rows.Speaker: Big Brother
rows.Line:
“That's it.
We're going on a journey to defeat an ogre!”

rows.Speaker: Big Brother
rows.Line: “Rumor has it that there's one two villages over causing quite a bit of trouble. It'll be a great way to test our skills!”

rows.Speaker: Little Brother
rows.Line:
“A-An ogre...?
There's no way I can fight one!”

rows.Speaker: Big Brother
rows.Line: “Hey, you know you're never going to get stronger if you keep acting that way...”

rows.Speaker: Little Brother
rows.Line: “But!”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “The young man tugs the boy along as they set off on their journey to defeat the ogre.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “But when they arrive at the next village, they find themselves surrounded by bandits.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is bad!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's a huge group of bandits...!

rows.Speaker: Bandit
rows.Line: “Put all your valuables on the ground and leave!”

rows.Speaker: Little Brother
rows.Line: “W-We're surrounded! What do we do...?!”

rows.Speaker: Big Brother
rows.Line:
“We have to create our own exit...!
Like this!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow! He just took out all those bandits while dodging their attacks!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. That's quite the physical feat.

rows.Speaker: Little Brother
rows.Line: “Whoa...!”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “Our two brothers continue their journey as the villagers thank them for their heroism along the way.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “And the boy, who started out so timid, began to feel all this courage welling up inside of him.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line:
“Finally, they arrive at their destination.
The mountain where the ogre is rumored to dwell...”

rows.Speaker: Burly Ogre
rows.Line: “Well met. I have been watching what you have both been doing from up here. You are heroes to those villagers, but do you have the skills to match...?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She looks so powerful...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah... She hasn't moved an inch, but she's exuding this terrifying aura...

rows.Speaker: Burly Ogre
rows.Line: “Hah! Looks like your bark was worse than your bite!”

rows.Speaker: Big Brother
rows.Line: “No! My sword...!”

rows.Speaker: Burly Ogre
rows.Line: “What hope do you have now that your sword is broken? Try this on for size!”

rows.Speaker: Big Brother
rows.Line: “Gwah!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, he lost!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
He was so close to winning too.
And then his sword broke...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(This is my chance to shine.
This is where the protagonist stops being a coward and works up the courage to fight.)

rows.Speaker: Burly Ogre
rows.Line:
“Is it your turn now?
Or do you plan on running and leaving your brother behind?”

rows.Speaker: Little Brother
rows.Line: “I have to fight...!”

rows.Speaker: Little Brother
rows.Line: “I've spent my life until now watching my big brother become a strong swordsman! Now it's my turn!”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Now it's my turn to show everyone what I've been practicing!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (First, we stay completely silent in order to build up the anticipation. Give Tsukasa and the others a chance to get on the edge of their seats.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Then, when MEIKO gives her signal...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Now!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Our swords clash and clang loudly!
Okay, our audience is watching us very closely.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (MEIKO and I just need to keep this up and stay in lockstep with each other until the end!)
Ten minutes later

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Great show, everyone.
That was an incredible display.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Especially your fight at the end, Len.
You were so amazing!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I agree. The way you kept barely dodging the ogre's attacks... I gulped each time you and MEIKO made a move!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I think we were all impressed considering how complicated that fight was. You must've practiced it quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. MEIKO and KAITO helped me a ton.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Don't give us all the credit.
I knew we could count on you as the lead.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I mean, our final showdown went as well as it did because you were able to move in perfect sync with me!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You've been thanking us, but I believe our show succeeded in the end because you worked so hard.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thanks...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (They counted on me to do my job as the lead. Hehe. That makes me really happy...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I was worried at first whether I could do what I saw them do...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (The staredowns, the buildup of anticipation, the sense that it'll all be over in a split second...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (But I feel like our sword fight was something out of an actual historical drama.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (So, I should keep finding ways to grow like this...!)
